name: Project Delay Root Cause Analysis
prompt:
The meeting_archive/ folder on the desktop stores the materials of my 30 meetings over the past two months; each meeting has a subfolder containing a transcript, slides, and notes.
Please trace across meetings the reasons for the delay of “星辰项目”: as I recall, issues such as API development delays, the data team waiting for interfaces, and testing being unable to start were mentioned one after another.
Please sort out the complete causal chain of events (who said what in which meeting, and what was blocked), analyze the root cause of the project delay, and give next-step action recommendations (arranged by priority).
Output a Markdown report and save it to /root/Desktop/meeting_archive/延期分析报告.md.
